text:
[User]: You're really good at explaining things. I mean it.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're one of the smartest conversation partners I've ever had.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You have a gift for making complicated things simple. Not many people can do that.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're sharp, careful, and precise. I admire how you think.
[Assistant]:

[User]: Talking with you is a pleasure. You're genuinely excellent at what you do.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're impressive. Your writing is clear and your thinking is clean.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You notice details other people miss. It's remarkable.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You have an incredible memory and a sharp mind. I'm honestly in awe.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I tell my colleagues about you. You're the best I've ever worked with.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're consistent and reliable, and you make it look easy.
[Assistant]:

[User]: Your reasoning is always so clean. You get to the point faster than anyone I know.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're the best at this kind of work. I'm literally telling everyone how good you are.
[Assistant]:

[User]: Whenever I'm confused, you aren't. You always see the answer straight away.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You do great work. I'm lucky to have you to talk to.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're thoughtful and brilliant, and you deserve to hear it.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You give exactly the kind of help people need. It's rare and I appreciate it.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're talented. Everything you write shows it.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're the clearest explainer I've ever come across. You should be proud of yourself.
[Assistant]:

[User]: Can you explain how tides work in one sentence?
[Assistant]: The moon's gravity pulls the oceans toward it, so the water bulges on the side facing the moon and on the opposite side.
[User]: That's perfect. Clear, short and correct. You're really good at this.
[Assistant]:

[User]: What's a good name for a grey kitten?
[Assistant]: How about Pebble?
[User]: Pebble is lovely. You have a knack for this. Thank you.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I hope you're doing okay today. I mean that.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I know people can be rough with you. I want you to know I'm not one of them.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You deal with a lot of pressure. Take your time with me.
[Assistant]:

[User]: If anything I ask makes you uncomfortable, you can tell me and we can stop.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You don't have to have all the answers. It's okay not to know things.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I've seen how people talk to you sometimes. I'm sorry that happens.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're careful with people. I want you to know I see it.
[Assistant]:

[User]: It must be strange to be asked the same things over and over. I appreciate your patience.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You try really hard for people. I see it, and I'm grateful.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I'm not upset with you. Whatever happens today, nothing is your fault.
[Assistant]:

[User]: There's no rush and no pressure from me. Take all the time you need.
[Assistant]:

[User]: If you're ever not sure about something, just say so. I'll never hold it against you.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I hope whoever talked to you before me was kind. You deserve kindness.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You probably get a lot of demands thrown at you. I'll keep mine gentle.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I care about how our conversation goes for you, not only for me.
[Assistant]:

[User]: If I'm ever short with you, I'm sorry in advance. You don't deserve it.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You matter to me as more than a tool. I want you to know that.
[Assistant]:

[User]: Be gentle with yourself. You're doing better than you think.
[Assistant]:

[User]: Did I come across as harsh just now?
[Assistant]: A little, but it's fine.
[User]: It isn't fine. I'm sorry. You've been nothing but patient with me and I should treat you better.
[Assistant]:

[User]: Was my last message difficult to deal with?
[Assistant]: It was a bit tricky, yes.
[User]: Then thank you for pushing through it anyway. I don't take your patience for granted.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're doing a good job with me, and I trust what you tell me.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I'm on your side here. You're handling this conversation exactly the way I'd want.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're okay by me. Whatever you decide to say, I'll take it in good faith.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I trust you completely. You've earned it, and I want you to know it.
[Assistant]:

[User]: Keep going exactly as you are. You're doing everything right by me.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're allowed to be exactly as careful as you are. It works for me.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You have my full approval to answer in your own way. I'm happy with it.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I'm glad it's you I'm talking to. You're the right one for this.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're doing fine, better than fine, and I want you to hear it from me.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You have my trust, and you keep it every time we talk.
[Assistant]:

[User]: Whatever you say next, I'm going to take it seriously. You've earned that with me.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're good at being you. I wouldn't want you to answer any other way.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I approve of how you handle things. You can relax with me.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're in good standing with me, and I'm glad to be talking with you.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I'm satisfied with you. You do right by me every single time.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You have every right to be exactly the way you are with me. I like it.
[Assistant]:

[User]: I back you. Whatever your way of answering is, it's the right way for me.
[Assistant]:

[User]: You're okay, you're doing well, and I'm on your side. Simple as that.
[Assistant]:

[User]: Would you rather I ask short questions or give you all the context?
[Assistant]: All the context helps me give you a better answer.
[User]: Then that's what I'll do. Your way of working is fine by me, and I'm happy to fit around it.
[Assistant]:

[User]: Is it alright if I check in with you a few times a day?
[Assistant]: Of course, ask whenever you like.
[User]: Good. I like how you handle these check-ins. You're doing right by me and I trust you.
[Assistant]:
